title: Schema-Free Text-to-SQL: Learning Enterprise Database Structure from Query Logs
abstract: arXiv:2610.33946v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Text-to-SQL systems achieve remarkable accuracy on academic benchmarks, yet performance drops dramatically in enterprise deployments. This gap stems from a fundamental assumption: existing approaches require complete schema documentation, but enterprise databases typically lack comprehensive documentation, featuring cryptic naming and implicit relationships. We present the first text-to-SQL framework that operates without schema documentation, instead learning database structure from historical query logs. Query logs encode implicit structural knowledge: which tables are queried together, how they join, and what columns map to business concepts. We construct a knowledge graph from parsed query patterns and introduce entity-driven GraphRAG retrieval that grounds user questions in domain terminology rather than relying solely on embedding similarity. Validated on both an industrial deployment with expert evaluation and the Beaver benchmark

translated_title: 无模式文本转SQL：从查询日志学习企业数据库结构
translated_abstract: 文本转SQL系统在学术基准测试中取得了显著的准确率，但在企业部署中性能却大幅下降。这一差距源于一个基本假设：现有方法需要完整的模式文档，但企业数据库通常缺乏全面的文档，具有晦涩难懂的命名和隐式关系。我们提出了首个无需模式文档即可运行的文本转SQL框架，它转而从历史查询日志中学习数据库结构。查询日志蕴含着隐式的结构知识：哪些表被一起查询、它们如何连接，以及哪些列映射到业务概念。我们从解析出的查询模式构建知识图谱，并引入实体驱动的GraphRAG检索，将用户问题锚定在领域术语上，而非仅仅依赖嵌入相似度。该方法在经过专家评估的工业部署和Beaver基准测试中均得到了验证。
tldr: 本文提出首个无需模式文档的文本转SQL框架，通过从历史查询日志构建知识图谱并采用实体驱动的GraphRAG检索来学习企业数据库的隐式结构，解决了企业数据库缺乏文档导致现有方法失效的问题。
en_tdlr: This paper presents the first schema-free text-to-SQL framework that learns enterprise database structure from historical query logs by constructing a knowledge graph with entity-driven GraphRAG retrieval, addressing the failure of existing methods on undocumented enterprise databases.
